The *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 11.1) is a text of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka located in the Paṭṭhāna collection [SuttaCentral]. It comprises the first triad combination (*tika*) combining the Wholesome Triad (*kusalattika*) with the Feeling Triad (*vedanāttika*) [Nyanatiloka 2007]. Its opening section on conditioning by dependency (*paṭicca-vāra*) articulates permutations such as: "Dependent on a wholesome (unwholesome, or neutral) phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, there may arise a wholesome, unwholesome, or neutral phenomenon associated with pleasant feeling, conditioned by way of root" [Nyanatiloka 2007].

While SuttaCentral does not record any curated parallels [SuttaCentral], DharmaNexus identifies extensive Pali-internal text reuse, calculating 2,554 matching passages across 115 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most significant internal reuse partners occur within other sections of the Paṭṭhāna, including *Kusalattika, Tika* (Patthana 5.1), *Vedanāttika* (Patthana 13.2), *Hetuduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.1), and parallel treatments of the same triad combination in *Kusalattika, Vedanāttika* (Patthana 23.1 and Patthana 17.1) [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also detects five machine-generated cross-language alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Abhidharmasamuccaya* (D4049) [DharmaNexus].
